newsitem.title: USA: Earthgrains gets favorable ruling on stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Earthgrains gets favorable ruling on stock buyback.

text.p: Earthgrains Co, a baked goods and refrigerated dough manufacturer, said Monday it obtained a favorable tax ruling from the U.S. Internal Revenue Service to proceed with a previously announced stock repurchase.

Under the stock repurchase program, authorized in March 1997, up to 500,000 shares of common stock on a pre-split basis, or about five percent of shares outstanding, may be repurchased. The repurchase program authorization extends through the end of calendar year 2000.
Earthgrains said the tax ruling confirmed that the stock repurchase program will not affect the tax-free nature of its spinoff in March 1996 from Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc.
The company said it will repurchase the shares in the open market.
